Bug_Explanation: The method showBug calls System.exit() which immediately halts the JVM. In a web application context, this would terminate the entire web server, affecting all other applications running on the same server.
Trigger_Explanation: The test cases in the generated JUnit test class call the showBug method on an instance of ApplicationServerSimulation. This method internally calls System.exit(), triggering the DoNotTerminateVM bug because it attempts to terminate the JVM, which is inappropriate in a web application context.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results show that the tests passed successfully without any errors or failures, indicating that the bug was not triggered during the test execution.
